title: A generalist vision-language foundation model for diverse biomedical tasks

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Traditional biomedical artificial intelligence (AI) models, designed for specific tasks or modalities, often exhibit limited flexibility in real-world deployment and struggle to utilize holistic information.
